templates.title: Build an approved change (its proposal is on main)
Propose the next roadmap row (a change to what a user can do; a one-sentence diff takes Fix or Ops instead)
templates.first_prompt: /propose {name}: its row of the change queue (sh .claude/roadmap-queue.sh --text). Put it in front of the owner for approval and stop there.

templates.title: Fix an issue (fast path: a diff that fits in one sentence needs no proposal)
templates.first_prompt: Fix GitHub issue {issue} on this branch. Start from the code as built, not the issue's write-up: find what it names in the code and check the premise first. This is the fast path, with no proposal: if the fix turns out to change what a user can do, or will not fit in one sentence, stop and say it needs /propose. Gate with scripts/ci/gate.sh, then land it with /merge-pr.

templates.title: Ops task (fast path: tooling, docs or process; no change proposal)
templates.first_prompt: This lane is the ops task {name}: tooling, docs or process, no change proposal. Say in one line that you are ready and wait for the task. Gate with scripts/ci/gate.sh, then land it with /merge-pr.
